turns.q: For a first-timer like me, what's the safest, easiest choice?
turns.replyTail:
Go slower if your dog is sensitive.

For grain-free, choose Chicken with Quinoa or Chicken with Pork; Chicken with Salmon isn’t grain-free.
If your dog enjoys Lily’s Kitchen core wet tins and trays, Fresh may be an easy step up, as they’re made in the same factory (excluding Organic and Ultimate).

Fresh is suitable from 4 months. Keep puppies on puppy recipes until they reach adult weight. For sensitivities, check ingredients and consult your vet.

Fresh Agent · AI says:

Great question! 🦋 To get started with Fresh, the main thing is following feeding guidance for your dog’s needs. You can serve Fresh Recipes alongside wet or dry food; for portion guidance, use Lily’s Kitchen online feeding calculator.

When switching, introduce Fresh gradually over about a week: begin with 4/5 of your dog’s current food and 1/5 Fresh, then slowly increase the Fresh food. Transition more gradually if your dog is sensitive. Fresh is cupboard fresh, so there’s no need to freeze or defrost. Refrigerate leftovers after opening and use within 2 days.
